system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "HPS2-THRIVE (25,673 patients, 3.9-year median follow-up) did not meet its primary endpoint of Major Vascular Event; the intended biomarker HDL-C is non-causal, the expected benefit from LDL-C lowering was modest (6.5% RRR), and a safety signal of excess non-fatal serious adverse events was reported.", "summary": "The HPS2-THRIVE trial randomized 25,673 high-risk vascular disease patients on statin therapy to extended-release niacin/laropiprant (TREDAPTIVE) or placebo and followed them for a median of 3.9 years. The study did not meet its primary endpoint — a composite of coronary death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, or revascularization (Major Vascular Event). The calculator, based on the observed LDL-C lowering of 0.31 mmol/L, predicted a hazard ratio of 0.935 (6.5% relative risk reduction) and noted 7,049 events would be needed for 80% power. The intended biomarker, HDL-C, was raised substantially (+18.4% in phase 2, +7 mg/dL in AIM-HIGH) but is non-causal for coronary disease per the reference table. A safety signal of increased non-fatal serious adverse events was confirmed in the 2012 announcement. The trial was not stopped early.
